==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From ''[[HTTP]]'' + ''[[magic cookie]]''.

===Pronunciation===
{{rfp|en}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-HTTP cookie.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|Internet}} A packet of [[information]] sent by a [[server]] to a [[World Wide Web]] [[browser]] and then returned by the browser each time it accesses that server, used to maintain state between otherwise [[stateless]] HTTP [[transaction]]s, for example, to identify the user.
#: {{syn|en|cookie<qq:ellipsis; the usual term>}}
#: {{hyper|en|magic cookie#Noun}}
